description: This file defines a React context provider (NotesProvider) for managing application-wide state related to notes and selected date, including CRUD operations, persistence to local storage, and placeholders for API integration. It also exports a custom hook useNotes to access the context.

methods.name: NotesProvider({ children })
methods.description: Provides application state for notes, selected date, and search query, with CRUD operations and persistence logic.

methods.name: useNotes()
methods.description: Custom hook to access the notes context within components.

methods.name: maybeCallApi
methods.description: Placeholder async function for future API calls, currently operates in local storage mode.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note object with provided payload data, adds it to state, and returns it.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with provided updater function or object.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by id from the state.
